_comment: Relay build backlog for /relay-loop. Each iteration: STAGE 0 triage -> pick highest-leverage todo -> build -> verify (tsc + vitest + real e2e when keys present) -> commit + push. STOP is valid. Free services only. Never touch mcp-forge. Secrets in .env only (gitignored).
product: Relay — text a Telegram bot; an agent + self-hosted anvil-engine browser fetches/processes data from any app and replies. Instinct (instinct.co) competitor. Free-infra MVP.
invariants: Free services only (Telegram long-poll, Gemini free tier, self-hosted anvil).
Do NOT modify C:/Users/acwic/mcp-forge. Merge improvements back via PRs later.
Secrets via .env (gitignored) — reuse redact-secrets; grep before every push.
anvil connect: POST /v1/sessions -> build ws(s)://host/cdp?session=<id>[&token=] yourself -> puppeteer.connect -> POST /v1/sessions/:id/release. Simple fetches: REST /v1/scrape.
LLM behind an adapter interface so Claude swaps in for Gemini in one line.
owner_blockers: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN in .env (from @BotFather) — needed for any live/e2e test.
GEMINI_API_KEY in .env (aistudio.google.com/apikey) — needed for the agent loop.
anvil-engine running + reachable at ANVIL_BASE_URL (local `docker run -p 3000:3000 anvil-engine`, or deployed) — needed for browser fetches.
Hosting decision for 24/7 (Oracle Always Free VM recommended) — item deploy-1.

items.task: TS project (package.json/tsconfig/gitignore/.env.example), copied libs (redact-secrets, url-validator), anvil client, telegram transport, stub index, unit test, backlog, README. Pushed to awictor/relay.
anvil client: createSession (builds CDP ws endpoint correctly), releaseSession, withBrowser (puppeteer connect+release), scrape (REST), anvilLive probe. src/anvil.ts.

DONE: src/llm.ts (LLMClient interface + ToolSpec/ToolCall/LLMMessage; GeminiClient free-tier impl mapping to generateContent functionDeclarations, Claude-swappable) + src/agent.ts (runAgent tool loop: scrape+reply tools, SSRF guard on scrape targets, RELAY_MAX_STEPS bound, step-budget fallback, scrapeFn injectable for tests). 4 offline unit tests w/ mock LLM (scrape->reply, SSRF-block, direct-answer, no-infinite-loop). tsc + 8/8 vitest green. NOTE: per-chat memory param exists (history) but wire-1 owns populating it.

DONE: index.ts wires Telegram msg -> runAgent(GeminiClient) -> reply, with per-chat rolling memory (6 turns) + graceful fallbacks when GEMINI_API_KEY/anvil missing. FIXED a real bug: anvil scrape() called REST /v1/scrape with no session (anvil returns 400 "No active session") -> now creates a session, scrapes with X-Session-Id, releases. VERIFIED end-to-end against live local anvil: relay scrape("https://example.com") -> real Chrome -> "Example Domain". call-tested browser pipe: TRUE. Full Telegram e2e still needs TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + GEMINI_API_KEY.

DONE: src/safety.ts — per-chat sliding-window rate limit (RELAY_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN, wired into index.handle), DANGEROUS_ACTION_RE guard (adapted from auto-scan; ready for agent-2 click/type), redactText (mask Bearer/AIza/sk-/telegram/hex in logs+replies) + redactObject. Wired: redacted inbound logging + rate-limit gate in index.ts. SSRF guard already on scrape targets (agent.ts). 7 new unit tests, 15/15 green. NOTE: relay redact-secrets SENSITIVE_KEY_RE now adds authorization|auth|bearer — DIVERGES from mcp-forge copy; keep in mind on merge-back.

DONE: multi-step browsing. anvil.ts + navigate/click/type/readCurrent (persistent session via X-Session-Id). agent.ts: BrowserBackend interface (injectable for offline tests) + tools browse/click/type/read holding one session per task, released in finally. Dangerous-action guard (safety.isDangerousAction) refuses destructive click/type (pay/buy/delete/submit/logout/...). FIXED a real bug: readCurrent first used /v1/scrape (requires url -> 400); anvil /v1/scrape always navigates, so readCurrent now uses /v1/actions/evaluate(document.body.innerText). VERIFIED live: navigate->readCurrent->release through relay code returned real page. 3 new browse-flow unit tests (mock backend). 18/18 vitest, tsc clean. call-tested browser path: TRUE.

DEPLOY ARTIFACTS DONE (provisioning still owner-gated): Relay Dockerfile (tiny node:22-slim worker, no port/no Chrome — anvil owns Chrome), docker-compose.yml (anvil + relay one network, relay->http://anvil:3000, healthcheck-gated depends_on, restart unless-stopped, env from .env), DEPLOY.md (exact Oracle Cloud Always Free steps + on-machine fallback + honest compute-not-vendor note). env var names verified consistent across .env.example/compose/anvil. tsc+18 tests green. OWNER STILL NEEDS: create the Oracle VM + provide TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + GEMINI_API_KEY in relay/.env, then docker compose up -d --build.
UX: typing indicator (sendChatAction), /start + /help commands, friendly errors, truncation notices, basic usage log.

history.note: Initial scaffold created by the build session (pre-loop). Channel->stub->anvil pipe runnable; agent loop is the next item.

Gemini agent loop + LLM adapter + 4 mock-LLM unit tests. Built offline (no keys/anvil needed). Next: wire-1 (replace index.ts stub with runAgent) — but wire-1's e2e needs TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + GEMINI_API_KEY + anvil reachable (owner-blockers).
index.ts -> runAgent + memory; fixed anvil scrape session bug; browser pipe verified live (relay->anvil->Chrome). Telegram/Gemini e2e still key-gated.
safety.ts: rate limit + dangerous-action guard + redaction; wired rate-limit + redacted logging into index. redact-secrets diverged from mcp-forge (added auth/bearer key match).
multi-step browse (navigate/click/type/read) + dangerous-action guard; fixed readCurrent (scrape-needs-url -> evaluate innerText); verified live nav+read+release.
Dockerfile + docker-compose + DEPLOY.md written and verified. Actual VM provisioning + tokens remain owner-gated.
